PAGE TITLE: APPENDIX | AWARDS
Certificate of Excellence in Accountability Reporting Award

PHOTOS:
- Group of eight people smiling and posing together on a stage with a blue and white patterned backdrop. Two people in the center hold framed certificates, and one person holds a glass award trophy. An inset in the lower-left corner shows a close-up of the glass award trophy. Caption: "AGA awarded NASA its prestigious CEAR Award and Best-in-Class Award, marking the 10th year NASA has been recognized for its excellence in financial reporting."
- Headshot of a man in a suit and tie outdoors with a mountain backdrop. Caption: "Frank E. Petersen, III ... Mr. Frank E. Petersen, III serves as NASA’s Deputy Chief Financial Officer for Finance. ... Mr. Petersen is currently serving as AGA's National President for 2024 – 2025."

KEY FACTS:
- AGA awarded NASA its prestigious CEAR Award and Best-in-Class Award.
- This marks the 10th year NASA has been recognized for its excellence in financial reporting.
- Mr. Frank E. Petersen, III serves as NASA’s Deputy Chief Financial Officer for Finance.
- Mr. Petersen is currently serving as AGA's National President for 2024 – 2025.
